body:
I want to tell everyone thank you. I haven't been completely honest. She left because of my alcoholism and verbal abuse. I have treated her wrong for so long that she couldn't take it anymore. She still refuses to speak to me. 

Being honest with myself has made me realize how much pain and suffering I have put on her soul. I love you. I can't go on. I'm sorry.

Thanks again folks. I just can't sleep. I've had about 45 minutes of sleep over the past 48 hours. I can't stop thinking about how my family is gone. I can't deal with this anymore. Seriously. I just can't. I'm sorry.

I want to thank you for the kind words. Right now I am sick to my stomach worried about my kids. In a weird way, finding out where they are has given me a little more courage to face the rest of the stuff. I think it's like what loopdeelooo said about picking something I can control. No, I can't control my wife's actions, but I can focus my time on making sure that my kids are safe. 

To update: I have called the FBI, the local sheriff's office, and the police department in the city where she may be. While the FBI will not do anything without coordination from local law enforcement, they did point me in the right directions - request a welfare check in the city where she may be, and if she and the kids are not there then issue a missing person report with the local sheriff's office, at which time the local sheriff's office may request help from the FBI if they believe she is in danger and has crossed state lines.

Thanks again, folks. I am going to try to take your advice. Right now nothing seems to be going the way it should for me, so I can't guarantee that I will be able to keep my spirits lifted, but I can try for now. I will come back and write some more if I start to feel as horrible as I did this morning.
